name: boxed-messages
description: Boxed chat messages for Claude Code: a colored bar and optional tinted background on your prompts (blue) and Claude's replies (orange)

showBars.title: Message bars
showBars.description: Colored bar left of your prompts and Claude's replies

showBackground.title: Message background
showBackground.description: Tint behind each message, a dimmed version of its bar color

backgroundShade.title: Background shade
backgroundShade.description: dark: dim tint for dark terminal themes. light: pastel tint for light terminal themes

userColor.title: Your color
userColor.description: Bar color of your prompts, as #rrggbb

claudeColor.title: Claude's color
claudeColor.description: Bar color of Claude's replies, as #rrggbb

tintStrength.title: Background strength
tintStrength.description: 0 to 1: how far the background moves from the bar color toward the theme (higher = subtler)
